propositions: Live focused prerequisite responses with top-level runner, model, trace_id, and _usage metadata fields are rejected as validation errors instead of normalized.
The normalize_coverage_records function applies extra-forbid validation to the entire response envelope rather than only the records payload.
Production-shaped responses containing standard runner metadata convert all expected records to indeterminate/output-invalid status, causing recall and validity metrics to drop to 0.0.
The focused prerequisite finder must normalize only the registered records payload while rejecting malformed, missing, duplicate, unknown, or cross-attributed records within that payload.
A valid production-shaped focused response with standard runner metadata should yield its finding/consistent records rather than output-invalid.
